url.label: Server URL
url.help: Base URL of your Vault server, including the port if non-standard (e.g. https://vault.example.com:8200). Must be reachable over HTTPS.

namespace.label: Namespace
namespace.help: Vault Enterprise / HCP namespace. Leave blank for open-source Vault.

issuer.label: OIDC issuer URL
issuer.help: Your identity provider's issuer URL. Postman discovers its endpoints via /.well-known/openid-configuration.

clientId.label: OIDC client ID
clientId.help: The public client ID registered with your identity provider for Postman.

mount.label: Vault auth mount path
mount.help: Path where Vault's JWT/OIDC auth method is enabled (default: jwt).

scopes.label: Additional scopes
scopes.help: Optional extra OIDC scopes, space-separated. 'openid' is always requested.

selector.label: Field selector
selector.help: JSON Pointer to a single field within the secret (e.g. /password). Required when the secret has more than one field.

secretVersion.label: Secret version
secretVersion.help: Optional specific version to read (KV v2 only). Defaults to the latest version.
